description: This file defines an interface 'ClusterMemberRemovedAware' that provides default implementations for subscribing to cluster events, handling member removal, and logging current cluster state within an Akka cluster environment. It facilitates actors to respond to cluster membership changes by removing data related to removed members and logging relevant information.

methods.name: receiveClusterMemberRemoved
methods.description: Returns a Receive object handling 'MemberRemoved' and 'CurrentClusterState' messages for cluster event processing.

methods.name: subscribeForClusterMemberRemovedAware
methods.description: Subscribes the actor to cluster MemberRemoved events using Akka cluster's subscribe method.

methods.name: memberRemoved
methods.description: Handles the removal of a cluster member, removing associated data from DDataWriter and logging the event.

methods.name: logCurrentClusterState
methods.description: Logs the current state of the cluster as an INFO message.
